expectation: Membrane/surface ring on nearly all nucleated cells (tumour, stroma, immune), so widespread and dense, with some tumour cells dim or negative. Empty space and acellular areas should be dark.
observed: A: most cores are broadly yellow over cellular tissue, with dark gaps in acellular areas and some cores dimmer. B: yellow outlines cell clusters and dark patches sit between them. C: patchy, dimmer, with nuclei-rich areas partly unstained. D: honeycomb of membrane-like edges.
why: Widespread membrane-pattern signal on cellular tissue, dark in acellular areas, with variable intensity as expected for B2M, including loss in some regions.
